Singapore International Graduate Award (SINGA) 2025 is an initiative of the Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A-STAR) for graduate applicants. The selected students will receive a monthly stipend of up to USD 3,200 (approximately ₹ 2,77,224) along with other benefits.

The *Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A-STAR) is Singapore's leading government agency dedicated to fostering world-class scientific research and talent for a vibrant knowledge-based economy.
Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A-STAR)
To be eligible, an applicant must:
have excellent academic records and a passion for research
have good skills in written and spoken English
SINGA is intended primarily for international students studying for the first time in Singapore.
Singaporeans, Singapore Permanent Residents and international students studying/who have studied in Singapore tertiary institutions are not eligible.
A-STAR may include additional selection criteria based on prevailing scholarship policies. These policies may be amended from time to time without notice.
The selected students will receive the award for up to four years of Ph.D. in the following ways:
A monthly stipend of USD 2,700 (approximately ₹2,34,082) will be increased to USD 3,200 (approximately ₹ 2,77,224) after passing the qualifying examination
One-time airfare grant of up to USD 1,500
Eligible candidates can apply for the opportunity by following the below-mentioned steps:
Click the 'Register' button and fill in the required registration details. (Note - If already registered, log in using Gmail/Mobile number/Email Id)
Navigate to 'Application Procedure' and click on the given link.
Fill in the required details to 'Register'.
After successful registration, log in using valid credentials.
Fill in the application form, upload the relevant documents and submit the form.
The students will be selected based on the fulfilment of the eligibility criteria
Do not mail any hard copy documents to the SINGA Office. All necessary documents are to be submitted online.
Only shortlisted candidates will be notified within 12 weeks from the application closing date.
Submit the applications as early as possible.
Ensure that the information provided during account registration in the application portal is accurate, as the information will be used for verification upon the applicant's first log-in.
Check and ensure that all data provided in the online application form is correct and accurate before submission. Amendments to the application will not be possible after it is submitted.
SIGNA stands for the Singapore International Graduate Award.
The Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A-STAR) is offering the SIGNA opportunity.
Question: What is the last date to apply for the SINGA?
The last date to apply is 01st June 2025.

This scheme offers tuition fees, a monthly stipend of USD 2,700 (approximately ₹2,34,082) will be increased to USD 3,200 (approximately ₹ 2,77,224) after passing the qualifying examination and other benefits.
Question: Can Indian students apply for this scheme?
Yes, Indian students are eligible to apply for this scheme.
